description: Defines the UnitConverterOperatorsPanel class for interacting with UI elements in a calculator test framework, specifically for unit conversion operations.

classes.name: UnitConverterOperatorsPanel
classes.description: Represents a panel in the calculator UI for unit conversion operations, providing access to buttons and elements such as Clear, Backspace, and unit labels.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Property that retrieves the current WindowsDriver session for interacting with UI elements.

methods.name: ClearButton
methods.description: Property that locates the 'Clear Entry' button in the UI.

methods.name: BackSpaceButton
methods.description: Property that locates the 'Backspace' button in the UI.

methods.name: Units1
methods.description: Property that locates the first unit label element.

methods.name: Units2
methods.description: Property that locates the second unit label element.
